properties.name: Foul ground at river/bay confluence
properties.source: noaa_chart_review: NOAA Chart Display Service (NCDS) WMS (gis.charttools.noaa.gov, MCS/NOAAChartDisplay), sublayers 0-12, reviewed 2026-07-27
properties.evidence: NOAA chart symbology marks charted "Foul" ground (obstruction/debris) directly at the confluence where the Choctawhatchee River South Mouth and the Jolly Bay complex open into Choctawhatchee Bay near the ICW.
properties.uncertainty: Polygon bounds are a rough box around the charted foul-ground symbol cluster read from a rendered WMS tile, not a precise charted extent.
